rules.body: Apply when immediate persistence becomes trailing persistence while document buffers outlive their views and saves can synchronously navigate. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Restart the quiet interval on each edit and persist only the latest pending text when it expires. Keep the task reusable for later bursts. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save."

Consume pending state before invoking save work, so synchronous callbacks can enqueue fresh work without the completed flush clearing it afterward. Preserve the ordering in src/workflow.php: "$value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;\n        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);"

Preserve pending drafts on switch, close, and disposal by completing departure persistence before the operation returns. Keep persistence owned by the document buffer and subscription cleanup owned by the badge; detaching the badge must not discard the draft. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." Original src/workflow.php: "function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$this->env->write($view->id,$text);}}" establishes persistence before an edit returns.

Treat saves and publication as possible synchronous navigation boundaries. After either can invoke navigation, verify that the outer request still has authority before clearing or installing document state. A superseded operation may finish cleanup of its captured departing badge but must preserve the newer navigation. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." Original src/workflow.php: "if(true&&$request!==$this->generation)return;"

Preserve document identity, text, status event semantics, and public interfaces. docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Preserve the departing badge's opportunity to receive its save status before removing its subscription.

Do not transfer the document's persistence policy to transient preview work. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.php: "function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}" Preserve preview's separate 40 ms interval, cancellation on hide, and subsequent reuse.

Verify latest-only persistence after 120 ms, interval restart on another edit, subsequent bursts, and pending drafts across switch, close, and disposal. Exercise synchronous navigation during departure saves and document publication, checking that nested navigation remains authoritative and status payloads retain their semantics. Check preview cancellation and reuse as preservation checks. These checks derive from the cited task and source behavior; evaluation observations add no requirements.

limitations: Departure flushing is inferred from preserving existing persistence behavior when writes become deferred; TASK does not expressly name flushing.
The supplied sources do not specify recovery from exceptions in saves or environment callbacks.
The sources establish synchronous listener reentry, not asynchronous decoding, subscription bootstrap, or startup cleanup races.
The reported passing examples do not prove exhaustive correctness, causality, or benefit on other tasks.
